subject: Agile Robots announces modular Agile ONE SN humanoid research reference platform
summary: Agile ONE SN combines a compact humanoid with Jetson Thor, preconfigured GR00T 1.7, URDF/USD simulation assets and an end-to-end reference workflow, with early-2027 availability planned. Agile claims skills and data may later transfer to its larger robot; third-party portability, delivery scale and lifecycle cost are unverified. The Agile and NVIDIA releases give inconsistent robot mass figures, which this record deliberately omits.
